facts.business: The Andhra Petrochemicals Limited manufactures Oxo-Alcohols (2-Ethyl Hexanol, N-Butanol, and Iso-Butanol) using Propylene as the primary raw material.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Company Performance is expected to be reasonably good in view of the forecast of better GDP growth for India

key_risks: Dependence on single source (HPCL) for major raw material Propylene
High logistic costs for alternative Propylene sources (BPCL, GAIL)
Geopolitical tensions (Russia-Ukraine war, Israel-Hamas war, Iran-Israel war, US trade war)
Competitive pricing and dumping by BPCL & IOCL
Cancellation of GAIL/APGDCL Natural Gas pipeline project
Lease renewal uncertainty for land from Visakhapatnam Port Trust
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with The Andhra Sugars Limited (Promoter) include purchase of goods (Rs 114.82 lakhs) and services received (Rs 0.25 lakhs). Dividend paid to promoters in previous year: The Andhra Sugars Ltd Rs 561.73 lakhs, APIDC Ltd Rs 20.16 lakhs, JOCIL Ltd Rs 183.60 lakhs. CSR expenditure of Rs 55.39 lakhs paid to Sri Mullapudi Venkatarayudu Memorial Medical Trust and Sree Mullapudi Venkataramanamma Memorial Hospital (entities under same management).
